lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Okay let's start. Quick check on last week's goals, then decisions. Alex, GitHub commits?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Commits are done. The Before agent pulls every engineer's commits from the REST API. PRs and review comments aren't in yet.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Posting to the channel works. DMs are blocked, we need workspace admin approval for the im:write scope.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Ingestion works with pasted text and JSON. I haven't touched Recall yet, so no live meetings.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: And I owed you the LLM decision. Let's decide now. I'm proposing Claude for all agents, it's the best at structured extraction in our tests.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Agreed, I'd rather have one provider.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Decision: Claude for every agent. Second decision, transcripts come from Recall.ai using the free meeting captions.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Works for me. I'll integrate the Recall bot by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: I'll add PRs and review comments to the Before agent, should be done Friday.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I'll chase the Slack admin to approve the DM scope.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: We also need someone to write the demo script for judging. Let's figure out who later.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Open question: do we keep transcripts after processing, or delete them for privacy? Let's think about it.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Meeting agent, please schedule our next sync Thursday at 3pm for 30 minutes with everyone.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: And generate a one-page visual report of this meeting so we can share it with the sponsors.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Also we need pizza for demo night, can the agent find a way to order it?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Sure, but nothing gets ordered without my approval. Okay, thanks everyone.
